text:
maria-support: FYI customer (FinEdge) is seeing intermittent 429s across EU/WEST and us-east-1 around 2026-03-16 14:22-14:28 UTC, asking for repro artifacts so we can correlate.
ajohnson: Got it — do we have any request IDs or client timestamps yet?
finedge-support: forwarding sample: X-Request-Id=req_fne_9a7c, client ts=2026-03-16T14:23:11Z, region=eu-west-1. They report spikes every ~10s for ~5m.
ryan-sre: @finedge-support can you also pull the exact sequence of requests (count per second) and confirm if they're going through a proxy? proxies often cause short bursts.
finedge-support: proxy=no, direct from their app. They attached a short timeline: 14:23:11 429, 14:23:21 200, 14:23:31 200, 14:23:41 429, 14:23:51 429 — looks bursty.
ajohnson: Thanks. Can you also collect response headers for a failed request (the 429) — we need X-RateLimit-* and Retry-After and the exact X-Request-Id. Minimal example output is fine (screenshot or copy-paste).
finedge-support: pasted headers from a 429 they saved:

HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
Date: Tue, 16 Mar 2026 14:23:41 GMT
Content-Type: application/json
X-Request-Id: req_fne_9a7c
X-RateLimit-Limit: 120
X-RateLimit-Remaining: 0
X-RateLimit-Reset: 1679065421
Retry-After: 10

maria-support: perfect. Next step: ask them to run a single-request curl that reproduces the 429 if possible, and to capture a HAR if they can reproduce the burst from their side. Provide this template:

```bash
# replace $KEY and $HOST
curl -v 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
  -H "User-Agent: FinEdgeApp/1.2" 
  'https://api.redwood.inference/v1/chat/completions' 
  -d '{"model":"redwood-1.1","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"hello"}]}'
```

ajohnson: Also ask them to include the exact client-side timestamp and any client retry logic. If they have an SDK, include the SDK version.
finedge-support: they use homegrown code (node fetch). I'll ask for code snippet and HAR.
ryan-sre: I pulled our edge logs for that window — saw a rapid series of accepted requests for api-key prefix finedge-xyz then a small drop where our rate limiter kicked in. I created a debug bundle for the window 2026-03-16T14:20:00Z -> 14:30:00Z.
sre-bot: debug bundle created: https://internal-artifacts.redwood/case-7890/2026-03-16-14-20-debugbundle.tar.gz (access: infra-team only)
ryan-sre: In our logs the pattern looks like short bursts from 54.210.XX.XX to the inference fleet, ~6 reqs in <2s, then back to normal — that explains X-RateLimit-Remaining hitting 0.
ajohnson: Good catch. We should confirm whether customer traffic is being multiplexed (multiple users behind one API key). FinEdge — are multiple processes/services sharing the same key?
finedge-support: yes it's a single key across a server pool (5 replicas). They didn't realize rate limits are per-key by default.
maria-support: action items:
- finedge-support: collect HAR and single-request curl using the template, include exact failing X-Request-Id(s) and client timestamps, and paste the node fetch snippet + SDK/version if any.
- ryan-sre: we've attached debug bundle link above; can you confirm if a temporary per-key throttle exemption or quota bump is needed while they implement key sharding?
- ajohnson: prepare guidance message on sharding keys + recommended per-key QPS and sample backoff settings (exponential with jitter).

finedge-support: will collect and upload HAR, and try per-process key split. ETA ~1 hour.
maria-support: thanks — once we have HAR + curl + the failing X-Request-Ids I'll correlate with the debug bundle and confirm whether this is expected rate-limit behavior vs a bug.
ryan-sre: Also note for internal triage: if Retry-After is present, client should respect it; but we also want to see if our limiter miscalculated the window (seen in other cases when burst smoothing disabled). I'll check limiter metrics.
ajohnson: sample response we expect after they split keys: X-RateLimit-Remaining should no longer drop to 0 for normal traffic; if still happens, collect full request timeline and we'll escalate.
finedge-support: uploading HAR now: https://uploads.finedge/cases/7890/har_2026-03-16.zip
finedge-support: uploaded curl output and node snippet in the ticket.
maria-support: ping when done so I can mark case with next steps. :thumbsup:
